A conical container is 21ft tall with a diameter of 14ft. The container is being emptied so that the liquid level lowers at a rate of 2ft/min. At what rate is the liquid volume decreasing when the liquid level is 16ft? Round your answer to one decimal place.

a
65.2πft3/min
b
44.8πft3/min
c
69.5πft3/min
d
32.6πft3/min
e
56.9πft3/min
